camera.reason: 50MP main camera with OIS plus a 5MP ultrawide, the only OIS camera in this bracket besides the HONOR X8d.

performance.reason: Helio G99 is smooth in daily use and light gaming but is the slowest chip among its rivals here.

battery.reason: 5,000mAh lasts a full day, but 25W charging is the slowest in the bracket.

display.reason: 6.7 inch FHD+ Super AMOLED, held back by a 90Hz refresh rate.

build.reason: Gorilla Glass Victus+ front on a plastic body with only IP54 splash resistance.

software.reason: Samsung promises 6 major Android upgrades and 6 years of security updates.

value.reason: Six years of updates and an OIS camera at 65,500 outweigh the older G99 chip and 25W charging.

availability.reason: In stock in all three colours at PriceOye and Mega.pk, with Samsung warranty and service centres nationwide.

notes: Pakistan model is the 4G Helio G99 version (SM-A175F), not the Exynos 1330 Galaxy A17 5G. PriceOye sells the 6GB 128GB at 65,695 against an official price of 72,999; Mega.pk lists it at 71,999. NFC is market dependent; WhatMobile lists it for Pakistan.
